charge_port.notes: Hyundai US lists the IONIQ 6 (22MY-25MY) among EVs with native CCS ports eligible for the CCS-to-NACS adapter.

Hyundai Canada FAQ: only the 2026+ IONIQ 5 and IONIQ 9 have a NACS port; other Hyundai EVs of MY2025 and earlier (and 2026 KONA Electric) have CCS and use an adapter. CCS1 inferred for the IONIQ 6 (not named on the page).

supercharger_access.notes: Free adapter (retail date on or before 2025-01-31, offer ended 2025-05-30) and dealer-sold adapter afterwards: an owner can use Tesla Superchargers through the CCS-to-NACS adapter.
Hyundai Canada FAQ: Hyundai EVs of MY2025 and earlier can use a NACS adapter (available separately; separate Hyundai Canada free-adapter offer until 2026-12-31 for eligible models).

wheels.notes: US SE AWD 18 in; Canadian 2023 Preferred AWD is also 18 in (Guide Auto), 2024 Canadian page not found.
With Ultimate Package (2023 Canadian page); 2024 not read.
